categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of peptide synthesis reagents, general-purpose molecular building blocks, and protein reagents. These products are specialized fine chemicals used in pharmaceutical research and manufacturing. The company also develops high-value specialty products including lipid nanoparticles, ionic liquids, PROTAC reagents, and nucleotide reagents to support global pharmaceutical R&D and production enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has established a comprehensive core technology system covering automated production technology, crystal particle size control technology, impurity detection and control technology, pipeline reaction technology, selective protection technology for complex organic molecules with multiple functional groups, enzyme reaction technology, protein crosslinker-specific membrane separation and purification technology, and low-temperature dehydration cyclization technology. The company employs systematic process development including small-scale trials, pilot optimization, and scale-up verification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 1,900 pharmaceutical research and production enterprises, CRO/CDMO companies, and scientific research institutions globally. Key customers include multinational pharmaceutical leaders like Bachem AG and Olon S.p.A, as well as domestic service outsourcing companies such as Pharmaron, Asymchem, and Kanglong. Major end markets include small molecule chemical drugs, peptide drugs, ADC drugs, and mRNA vaccine development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Suzhou High-tech Zone. It has established production bases in Anqing and Huai'an, Anhui Province. The company has significant international presence with sales to Asia (22.13% of revenue), Europe (10.04%), and Americas (4.09%). In January 2025, the company established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Germany (Highfine Biotech GmbH) to serve European CDMO and formulation customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It provides specialized chemical reagents and building blocks used by pharmaceutical companies and CRO/CDMO organizations in drug research and manufacturing. The company is positioned as a supplier of critical raw materials and intermediates for pharmaceutical development and production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes research and development as its core strategy, focusing on optimizing synthesis processes and developing new products. Key R&D initiatives include developing nanoparticle lipid reagents, ionic liquids, PROTAC reagents, nucleotide reagents, and high-value specialty products. The company invests heavily in process optimization, cost reduction, and expanding its product pipeline to support emerging pharmaceutical research directions including ADC drugs and mRNA vaccines.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of chemical reagents and molecular building blocks to pharmaceutical companies, CRO/CDMO organizations, and research institutions. Revenue is recognized when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon delivery. The company operates both domestic (63.74% of 2024 revenue) and international sales channels (36.26%), with products sold through direct customer relationships and established distribution networks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a market leader in peptide synthesis reagents, particularly in advanced phosphonium and uronium-type condensing agents (HATU, HBTU, TBTU, PyBOP). It competes with smaller regional manufacturers and international specialty chemical suppliers. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolios, superior quality control, reliable supply, and strong customer relationships with major pharmaceutical enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 451.87 million yuan, representing 16.22% growth from 388.79 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 134.05 million yuan in 2024, up 35.44% from 98.97 million yuan in 2023. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with total assets of 2.35 billion yuan and net assets of 2.27 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024. Operating cash flow increased 43.88% to 126.37 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolios covering 160+ peptide synthesis reagents and 800+ molecular building block variants; (2) superior quality control with impurity management and batch consistency; (3) rapid market responsiveness with maintained inventory of main products; (4) technical service capabilities enabling custom product development; (5) established relationships with 1,900+ global customers including major pharmaceutical enterprises; (6) strong brand recognition in peptide synthesis reagents; and (7) continuous innovation in high-barrier specialty products like lipid nanoparticles and ADC reagents.
